question: How is one situated in the midst of the yogini group designated in Kula doctrine?
premises: The person is situated in the middle of the yogini group.
Such a person is called paśu.
This designation is given in the Kula tradition.
inference: In Kula doctrine, one placed in the midst of the yogini group is called a paśu.
uncertainties: The evaluative sense of paśu in this context may be technical.
plain_english: In the Kula tradition, he who is situated in the middle of the yogini group is called a paśu.
